snippet.title: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves arrives digitally October 22, 2026 and physically January 2027 to Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order to receive Mai Shiranui’s Classic Costume: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fatal-fury-city-of-the-wolves-standard-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01
 
The winner of Best Fighting Game at The Game Awards 2025, FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves, is coming to Nintendo Switch 2! Experience intense battles and unique fighters in the latest entry in the Fatal Fury series.

#NintendoDirect #FatalFury #CotW

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot
